messages:
felix: Heads-up team  planning a focused OSS refapp + 12-min micro-tutorial drop next Wed. Goals: 300 repo views, 100 GH stars, 60 RSVPs. Need owners for blog post + HN blurb, bench slide, CLI quickstart, RSVP flow, contributor onboarding note, and inbound routing. who takes what? :wave:

nadia: I can take the blog + HN blurb. I'll draft two angles: "quick hands-on" and "bench-first". will include a small contributor section for folks who want to PR examples.

quentin: Ill do the benchmark slide and a tiny methods blurb. planning p50/p95 + $/1k tokens for hosted vs dedicated, tested at 512 tokens, batch=4. will attach PNG to the ticket.

isaac: I can own the CLI quickstart and the GitHub README refresh. will add a short `cli install && refapp run --example conv` snippet and a 3-step Quickstart.

felix: nice. also want a short "how to contribute" footer for the refapp (labeling issues good-first-issue, sample prompts, tests). nadia pls include contributor CTA.

quentin: bench ETA tomorrow EOD. will post a tiny table here: 
```
model, p50_ms, p95_ms, $/1k
hosted-small, 120, 320, $0.45
dedicated-2gpu, 78, 190, $0.22
```

nadia: good table. marketing ask: well A/B test hero copy on the landing page: outcome-first vs technical-first vs community-first. run for 72h, KPI CTR->RSVP >= 2.5%.

isaac: RSVP flow: capture name, email, company_size (opt), job_title (opt), use_case (free-text). utm params: utm_source=ossdrop, utm_campaign=refkit_apr. routing: company_size >=100 or job_title contains "platform|infra" -> AE queue else nurture. Tag all leads `ref:refkit`.

dev-rel-bot: Created ticket MK-8147: "RefKit OSS drop - checklist" assigned to nadia, quentin, isaac. Reminder set 48h before launch.

felix: also planning a short community AMA 1 week after launch. think we should include a link to a short evaluation harness and invite contributors to submit prompts. nadia add an invite in the blog.

quentin: quick note for messaging: in the bench blurb call out "real-world prompts" and include the batch parameter. transparency helps trust.

isaac: for contributor onboarding: add a small script to run example tests `scripts/run_examples.sh` and a PR checklist. will add that to README.

nadia: confirmed. I'll upload two blog drafts and three hero variants into MK-8147 by EOD.

quentin: confirmed. will upload PNG + raw CSV to the ticket.

isaac: confirmed. will push README patch and CLI snippet to a branch and open a PR.

felix: booked a 20m prep Mon 09:30 PT to walk through the bench slide, CLI demo, and RSVP page. if anyone sees blockers ping here. :rocket:
